label: development, not a verdict
reading_rules: A figure is a check on days that were already seen. Nothing here is a verdict, nothing is registered and no choice is made on it.

A gain of (s3c) over a reference is read as present on a split when the 90% interval of mean d excludes zero on the positive side, and as a loss when it excludes zero on the negative side; otherwise as undecided. A point estimate alone is not read.

A pooled figure is never read without the regime (development window) or month (2026) and pressure-day-type splits beside it. The upper-tail figures of the 2026 window rest on few pressure days; the page states the counts.
Lens C's caveat is stated on the page. The day-type and month intervals are labelled as the current method (#1221 open, #1228).
The page ends with marked questions for Eleonora with numbered options and defaults that change no claim.
